map.oc.notes: Google-free Indiana map (opens on Fort Wayne). STATEWIDE since 2026-10-30: 707 verified live public cameras (704 INDOT 511 + 3 WeatherSTEM, all byte-verified; 704 with HLS) in cameras-in.json; FW's 55 stay baked as the default view. Addendum features: 'Can they see me?' (120 m ESTIMATED coverage, dead-zone answer, 6 s watch cycle), coverage/dead-zone layer, OSRM route planner with camera scoring. Plus RainViewer radar, police dispatch radio (OpenMHz), incidents, Open-Meteo weather. Tor .onion door serves a local copy incl. cameras-in.json.

NOTE: front end is Worker-served — the Cloudflare account is at its 20-project Pages limit (all live products), so onioncore-source.pages.dev could not be created yet; deploy.py lights it up automatically when a slot frees.
